This is an application filed under Order XXXIX Rules 1 and 2 CPC on behalf of the Plaintiff seeking ex parte ad interim injunction against the Defendants.

21. Mr. V. S. Krishna, learned counsel for the Plaintiff has set out the case of the Plaintiff as under:
21.1.

The Plaintiff, incorporated under the laws of Singapore, is a part of the Danone Group of companies engaged in the business of specialized nutrition market as well as in the dairy and plant-based products market, with an established presence in the market for packaged water, as well.

Plaintiff works in close collaboration with the medical community, including doctors, health authorities, etc. and its unique product range is designed to give health care professionals the scope to select nutritional options that are accurately targeted to support specific management regimes and to enhance patient recovery.
21.2.

The Plaintiff's trademark 'PROTINEX' was originally registered by Dumex Limited and was later acquired by the Pfizer group in 1972, finally being acquired by the Wockhardt Group in 2006 eventually being held by Wockhardt EU Operations (Swiss) AG.

In 2012, the Wockhardt EU Operations (Swiss) AG executed a deed of assignment in favour of the Plaintiff, transferring all its intellectual properties, goodwill and ancillary rights on the registered trademark 'PROTINEX' and its associated trade dresses, to the Plaintiff.
The details of the relevant trademark registrations and applications, registered in India, are mentioned at paragraph 46 of the plaint.
The Plaintiff has also applied for copyright of the unique style, distinctive colour scheme and get up of its 'PROTINEX' labels and has obtained registrations under the Copyright Act, 1957.
The details of the copyright registrations are mentioned at paragraph 57 of the Plaint. 21.4.
The Plaintiff has been exclusively distributing its products through Nutricia International Private limited under the mark 'PROTINEX' and has garnered tremendous sales.
The gross sales and the marketing expenses up till 31st March, 2024 is Rs. 3,058.51 lakhs and Rs. 902.03 lakhs, respectively.
The details of the gross sales and marketing expenses from 2022-2024 is mentioned at paragraph 37 of the plaint.

30. The Plaintiff has also secured an injunction order, in its favour, in CS(COMM) 905/2024 on 16.10.2024 with respect to a similar impugned mark 'PROTEX, where the Court held that 'PROTEX'
